RUST-01-ownership-evidence/README.md.content:
# Ownership, moves and cleanup

Trace a complete Rust program through functions before changing its behavior.
This pack belongs to RSS1. It builds on the RSS0 Cargo workflow; it introduces
ownership of String, Vec and Packet values, explicit clones, and scope cleanup.

Both roles contain the same working code and diagnostics. The starter worksheet
leaves predictions and evidence open; the reference explains them.

## Files and environment

Use Rust 1.97.1 with Cargo, rustfmt and Clippy, edition 2024, on the native Linux
x86-64 validation environment. The source is safe Rust and uses only the standard
library. Cargo.lock is supplied; no crate download is needed during these checks.
Keep the root README and one complete role together. Each role has Cargo.toml,
Cargo.lock, src/main.rs, observations.md and six diagnostic source files.

After extracting a selected-role archive, enter starter or solution as applicable:

```sh
cd starter
rustc -Vv
cargo -V
cargo fmt --all --check
rustfmt --edition 2024 --check diagnostics/*.rs
cargo clippy --locked --offline --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo test --locked --offline
cargo run --locked --offline
cargo run --locked --offline -- 'alpha'
cargo run --locked --offline -- 'alpha' empty
```

Cargo may print build messages on stderr. Distinguish them from the program's
own stderr and record exit status. To observe just the program after building:

```sh
cargo build --locked --offline
./target/debug/ownership_trace_lab
./target/debug/ownership_trace_lab alpha empty
```

If CARGO_TARGET_DIR is set, use that configured output directory instead.

## Core: an owner ledger

String and Vec own their contents. Passing them by value into make_packet
transfers that ownership; the returned Packet owns both fields. Passing a Packet
by value to relay transfers the entire value into that parameter, then returns
ownership. The old binding cannot be used as an owner after the move. A move is
a language-level ownership rule; source tracing alone does not show whether a
compiler copies, elides or rearranges machine data.

The u32 value implements Copy, so assigning copied_id leaves both integer
bindings usable. Packet does not implement Copy. Its explicit clone produces
independent String and Vec contents. Changing that clone does not change the
original. Cloning may allocate; no timing claim is part of this exercise.

Before running, fill OWNER LEDGER and PREDICT. Follow the actual names in
ownership_trace: label and bytes, packet, snapshot, moved, updated, returned.
In add_marker, follow the owned fields through destructuring, append_marker and
reconstruction. A reference such as &Packet or &str permits inspection without
taking ownership. Read borrowed_label before moving updated through relay.
Detailed borrowing restrictions and lifetime design continue in RSS2.

The default program stdout is exactly:

```text
copy=7,7
owned=packet-42 bytes=[3, 1, 4]
cloned=packet-42 bytes=[3, 1, 4]
after-edit=packet-42 bytes=[3, 1, 4, 9]
snapshot=packet-42 bytes=[3, 1, 4]
borrowed-label=packet-42
returned=packet-42 bytes=[3, 1, 4, 9]
drop=inner-second
drop=inner-first
drop=explicit
after-explicit-drop
drop=outer
```

For a changed label, replace each packet-42 with that exact text. The empty
mode changes the original/snapshot vector to [] and the updated/returned vector
to [9]. Valid runs have no program stderr and status 0. A bad vector mode, a
third argument, or a non-UTF-8 label is refused with status 64 and no stdout.
No file, network service or external target is opened by this program.

Compare actual output to predictions; mark the exact call that moves each value.
Complete CHECKS and LIMITS. The four baseline unit tests check concrete helper
behavior. They do not complete the written owner ledger.

## Continuation: scope cleanup

Continue in the same saved project. In scope_trace, predict which ScopeTag is
dropped at each closing brace and at the explicit drop call. Locals in this
ordinary block drop in reverse declaration order. drop(explicit) consumes the
tag before the following println, while outer remains until the function ends.
Complete SCOPE using the actual five-marker sequence above.

ScopeTag prints from its own Drop implementation. Those markers illustrate these
particular destructor calls. They do not measure allocations, reveal memory
addresses, log every automatic String/Vec cleanup, or prove a speed advantage.
The destructor runs before its fields are destroyed. More general temporary,
pattern and panic/unwinding rules are outside this introductory trace.

## Choice: independent owned data

Keep the saved baseline and complete CHOICE. Add one named unit test with a
new label and vector, including an empty or repeated-value case. Clone the
Packet, change the clone's label and bytes, and assert every field in both
values. Keep the baseline tests. Explain the need for a clone when two separately
editable owned values are required, compared with a borrowed read-only view.
Run formatting, Clippy and all tests again; attach the actual result and one
statement of what the added assertion would fail to catch.

## Challenge: three compile refusals and their paired fixes

Predict the result before each command. Use a disposable output directory:

```sh
ownership_lab_dir=$(mktemp -d)
rustc --edition=2024 --emit=metadata diagnostics/use-after-move.rs -o "$ownership_lab_dir/move.rmeta"
rustc --edition=2024 --emit=metadata diagnostics/use-after-drop.rs -o "$ownership_lab_dir/drop.rmeta"
rustc --edition=2024 --emit=metadata diagnostics/copy-owned.rs -o "$ownership_lab_dir/copy.rmeta"
rustc --edition=2024 diagnostics/returned-owner.rs -o "$ownership_lab_dir/returned-owner"
rustc --edition=2024 diagnostics/last-use-before-drop.rs -o "$ownership_lab_dir/last-use-before-drop"
rustc --edition=2024 diagnostics/clone-owned.rs -o "$ownership_lab_dir/clone-owned"
"$ownership_lab_dir/returned-owner"
"$ownership_lab_dir/last-use-before-drop"
"$ownership_lab_dir/clone-owned"
```

The first two commands refuse compilation with E0382; the third refuses with
E0204. They intentionally do not produce runnable programs. Diagnostic
wording and spans are observations to record, not outputs to invent. The paired
fixed programs print packet-42, packet-42, and packet-42|packet-42! respectively,
each with a final newline, empty stderr and status 0. Complete CHALLENGE: name
what was consumed, what later use was forbidden, and why each fix matches a
different desired behavior. Keep the failing examples intact.

Use an output directory owned by the current experiment and retain diagnostics
before removing that directory. Do not infer a runtime crash from a compile-time
refusal. The scope is supplied local text and values; no unsafe code or manual
memory deallocation is needed.

## Walkthrough and independent completion

First predict the owner ledger and output without the reference. Step through
each helper with an instructor or annotate it independently. Then run the exact
selected role, compare observations, and choose the independent-data test or the
compiler challenge. The reference supplies reasoning to compare afterward; it
does not replace local versions, hashes, output or an explanation of a mismatch.

Retain the edited source, observations and commands together. The core, scope
continuation, choice and challenge are four different tasks in the same workspace.

## Language references

- [Ownership, moves and clone](https://doc.rust-lang.org/book/ch04-01-what-is-ownership.html)
- [References and borrowing](https://doc.rust-lang.org/book/ch04-02-references-and-borrowing.html)
- [Destructor and drop-scope rules](https://doc.rust-lang.org/reference/destructors.html)

test/verify_rust_ownership.py.content:
"""Validate the complete RSS1 roles, ownership traces and intentional compiler refusals."""
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import signal
import subprocess
import tempfile
import tomllib

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PACK=ROOT/'RUST-01-ownership-evidence'
parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument('--proof',type=Path,required=True)
args=parser.parse_args();args.proof=args.proof.resolve()
assert not args.proof.exists()
assert os.getuid()!=0 and os.uname().sysname=='Linux' and os.uname().machine=='x86_64'
OUT=args.proof.parent;OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
commands=[]

def sha(raw):return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def stop(signum,_frame):raise SystemExit(128+signum)
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,stop);signal.signal(signal.SIGINT,stop)

def run(command,cwd,label,expected=0,env=None):
    entry=dict(parentTaskId='rust-ownership-evidence',parentPid=os.getpid(),command=[os.fsdecode(value) for value in command],cwd=str(cwd),
               startTime=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat(),timeoutSeconds=120)
    child=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=cwd,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,start_new_session=True)
    entry['pid']=child.pid
    with (OUT/'processes.jsonl').open('a') as stream:stream.write(json.dumps(dict(entry,event='start'))+'\n')
    stdout,stderr=b'',b'';cleanup='owned process exited'
    try:stdout,stderr=child.communicate(timeout=120)
    except BaseException:
        if child.poll() is None:
            os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
            try:stdout,stderr=child.communicate(timeout=3)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGKILL);stdout,stderr=child.communicate()
        cleanup='owned process group terminated and reaped';raise
    finally:
        with (OUT/'processes.jsonl').open('a') as stream:
            stream.write(json.dumps(dict(entry,event='end',endTime=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat(),exitCode=child.returncode,childProcessGroupCleanup=cleanup))+'\n')
        (OUT/(label+'.stdout.txt')).write_bytes(stdout);(OUT/(label+'.stderr.txt')).write_bytes(stderr)
    assert child.returncode==expected,(label,child.returncode,stderr.decode(errors='replace'))
    commands.append(dict(label=label,exitCode=child.returncode,stdoutSha256=sha(stdout),stderrSha256=sha(stderr)))
    return stdout,stderr

source_names=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--','RUST-01-ownership-evidence','.github/workflows/rust-ownership.yml','test/verify_rust_ownership.py'],cwd=ROOT).decode().splitlines()
assert len(source_names)==24 and len(set(source_names))==24
source={name:(ROOT/name).read_bytes() for name in source_names}
for name,raw in source.items():
    target=OUT/'source'/name;target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);target.write_bytes(raw)
versions={}
for name,command in [('rustc',['rustc','-Vv']),('cargo',['cargo','-V']),('rustfmt',['rustfmt','--version']),('clippy',['cargo','clippy','--version'])]:
    versions[name]=run(command,ROOT,'version-'+name)[0].decode()
assert 'release: 1.97.1\n' in versions['rustc']

labels=['packet-42','alpha','','🦀','café','a b','../local','--label','\tvalue\nnext']
state=0x0A11CE42
for index in range(33):
    chars=[]
    for _ in range(index):
        state=(state*1664525+1013904223)%2**32;chars.append(chr(1+state%127))
    labels.append(''.join(chars))
assert len(labels)==42

def expected_output(label,empty):
    initial=[] if empty else [3,1,4]
    changed=initial+[9]
    lines=['copy=7,7',f'owned={label} bytes={initial}',f'cloned={label} bytes={initial}',
           f'after-edit={label} bytes={changed}',f'snapshot={label} bytes={initial}',
           f'borrowed-label={label}',f'returned={label} bytes={changed}',
           'drop=inner-second','drop=inner-first','drop=explicit','after-explicit-drop','drop=outer']
    return ('\n'.join(lines)+'\n').encode()

roles=[]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='rust-ownership-evidence-') as temporary:
    work=Path(temporary)
    for role in ['starter','solution']:
        selected=PACK/role;directory=work/role;shutil.copytree(selected,directory)
        role_out=OUT/role;role_out.mkdir()
        env={**os.environ,'CARGO_TARGET_DIR':str(work/(role+'-target')),'CARGO_TERM_COLOR':'never'}
        manifest=tomllib.loads((directory/'Cargo.toml').read_text())
        lock=(directory/'Cargo.lock').read_bytes()
        assert manifest['package']['edition']=='2024' and 'dependencies' not in manifest
        assert tomllib.loads(lock.decode())['package']==[{'name':'ownership_trace_lab','version':'0.1.0'}]
        run(['cargo','fmt','--all','--check'],directory,role+'-format',env=env)
        diagnostic_paths=sorted(str(p.relative_to(directory)) for p in (directory/'diagnostics').glob('*.rs'))
        assert len(diagnostic_paths)==6
        run(['rustfmt','--edition','2024','--check',*diagnostic_paths],directory,role+'-diagnostic-format',env=env)
        run(['cargo','clippy','--locked','--offline','--all-targets','--','-D','warnings'],directory,role+'-clippy',env=env)
        assert b'4 passed; 0 failed' in run(['cargo','test','--locked','--offline'],directory,role+'-tests',env=env)[0]
        run(['cargo','build','--locked','--offline'],directory,role+'-build',env=env)
        binary=Path(env['CARGO_TARGET_DIR'])/'debug/ownership_trace_lab'
        default=run([str(binary)],directory,role+'-default',env=env)
        assert default==(expected_output('packet-42',False),b'')
        for index,label in enumerate(labels):
            for mode in ['default','empty']:
                stdout,stderr=run([str(binary),label,mode],directory,f'{role}-input-{index}-{mode}',env=env)
                assert stdout==expected_output(label,mode=='empty') and not stderr
        for suffix,arguments,message in [
            ('bad-mode',['label','other'],b'usage: ownership_trace_lab [label [default|empty]]\n'),
            ('extra',['label','default','extra'],b'usage: ownership_trace_lab [label [default|empty]]\n'),
            ('invalid-utf8',[b'\xff'],b'label must be valid UTF-8\n')]:
            command=([os.fsencode(binary),*arguments] if suffix=='invalid-utf8' else [str(binary),*arguments])
            stdout,stderr=run(command,directory,role+'-'+suffix,expected=64,env=env)
            assert not stdout and stderr==message
        for name,code in [('use-after-move','E0382'),('use-after-drop','E0382'),('copy-owned','E0204')]:
            target=role_out/(name+'.rmeta')
            stdout,stderr=run(['rustc','--edition=2024','--emit=metadata','diagnostics/'+name+'.rs','-o',str(target)],directory,role+'-'+name,expected=1,env=env)
            assert not stdout and code.encode() in stderr and not target.exists()
        fixed_hashes={}
        for name,output in [('returned-owner',b'packet-42\n'),('last-use-before-drop',b'packet-42\n'),('clone-owned',b'packet-42|packet-42!\n')]:
            target=role_out/name
            run(['rustc','--edition=2024','diagnostics/'+name+'.rs','-o',str(target)],directory,role+'-'+name+'-build',env=env)
            assert run([str(target)],directory,role+'-'+name+'-run',env=env)==(output,b'')
            fixed_hashes[name]=sha(target.read_bytes())
        run(['cargo','clean'],directory,role+'-clean',env=env);assert not binary.exists()
        assert b'4 passed; 0 failed' in run(['cargo','test','--locked','--offline'],directory,role+'-clean-tests',env=env)[0]
        run(['cargo','build','--locked','--offline'],directory,role+'-clean-build',env=env)
        assert run([str(binary)],directory,role+'-clean-default',env=env)==default
        assert (directory/'Cargo.lock').read_bytes()==lock
        assert all(p.read_bytes()==(selected/p.relative_to(directory)).read_bytes() for p in directory.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
        shutil.copyfile(binary,role_out/'ownership_trace_lab')
        roles.append(dict(role=role,inputCases=84,unitTests=4,unitTestsBeforeAndAfterClean=True,sourceAndLockUnchanged=True,
                          actualScopeTrace=['inner-second','inner-first','explicit','after-explicit-drop','outer'],
                          compilerRefusals={'use-after-move':'E0382','use-after-drop':'E0382','copy-owned':'E0204'},
                          fixedExecutableSha256=fixed_hashes,executableSha256=sha(binary.read_bytes())))
assert not work.exists() and all((ROOT/name).read_bytes()==raw for name,raw in source.items())
assert len(commands)==216,len(commands)
proof=dict(sourceRevision=os.environ.get('SOURCE_REVISION'),sourceFiles={n:sha(r) for n,r in source.items()},
           compilerVersions=versions,commands=commands,roles=roles,nativeExecuted=True,ordinaryUser=True,
           allSourceFilesUnchanged=True,temporarySourceCleanup=True,externalDependencyDownloadsDuringChecks=False,
           worksheetCompletionNotInferred=True,allocationOrTimingClaimsNotInferred=True)
args.proof.write_text(json.dumps(proof,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(sourceFiles=24,commands=len(commands),inputCases=168,compilerRefusals=6,fixedPrograms=6,temporarySourceCleanup=True)))

.github/workflows/rust-ownership.yml.content:
name: Rust ownership evidence

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "RUST-01-ownership-evidence/**"
      - "test/verify_rust_ownership.py"
      - ".github/workflows/rust-ownership.yml"
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "RUST-01-ownership-evidence/**"
      - "test/verify_rust_ownership.py"
      - ".github/workflows/rust-ownership.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN: "1.97.1"
      SOURCE_REVISION: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install the recorded course toolchain
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.97.1 --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy
      - name: Verify roles, owner traces and compiler refusals
        run: python3 test/verify_rust_ownership.py --proof output/rust-ownership/proof.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        if: always()
        with:
          name: rust-ownership-evidence
          path: output/rust-ownership/
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error

RUST-01-ownership-evidence/solution/obse.content:
# Ownership reference observations

## OWNER LEDGER
The String and Vec values move into make_packet; the returned Packet owns both.
clone creates a second Packet whose String and Vec own independent data. relay
moves its Packet parameter back to its caller. add_marker takes the Packet,
destructures it into owned fields, moves bytes through append_marker, then
rebuilds a complete Packet. borrowed_label uses a shared borrow; that inspection
does not take ownership. The final relay moves updated into returned. The u32
assignment copies 7, so both integer bindings remain usable.

## PREDICT
Default data is label packet-42 and bytes [3, 1, 4]. The cloned snapshot retains
those values when the moved branch gains 9. The empty-vector branch starts with
[] and ends with [9]. Changed labels are preserved as text, including Unicode.
Normal program stderr is empty and status is zero. Invalid vector mode, extra
arguments, or a non-UTF-8 label are refused with status 64 before trace output.

## CHECKS
Retain actual local versions, hashes and output; a reference explanation is not
a substitute for running the selected role. Four baseline unit tests cover
moves through helpers, independent cloned fields, empty fields and borrowing
before a later move. Passing them does not complete the observation worksheet.

## SCOPE
The sequence is inner-second, inner-first, explicit, after-explicit-drop, outer.
The inner local tags drop in reverse declaration order when their block ends.
std::mem::drop consumes explicit before the next println. The outer tag drops
when scope_trace returns. ScopeTag logs its own destructor; it does not log all
String/Vec destruction, allocator activity, object addresses or code generation.
No equivalent cost claim follows from this sequence.

## CHOICE
A useful independent-clone test changes both fields in the clone and checks all
fields in both results. Merely asserting that the clone initially equals the
original does not check later independence. The snapshot behavior needs its own
owned data; a read-only description alone can borrow and need not clone.

## CHALLENGE
use-after-move and use-after-drop are expected E0382 compile refusals. consume
and drop take the String by value, so the later println cannot borrow that old
binding. returned-owner passes ownership back; last-use-before-drop observes the
value first and consumes it afterward. copy-owned is expected E0204 because its
String field is not Copy. clone-owned explicitly clones, then demonstrates that
editing the clone leaves the first value intact. None of the rejected programs
has an observed runtime behavior. Compare actual diagnostic versions and spans.

## LIMITS
This lab illustrates checked ownership and explicit duplication in safe Rust.
It does not establish resource bounds, authorization correctness, constant cost,
or the absence of logic bugs. A clone can allocate; a moved value does not by
itself reveal actual machine-level data movement. Native observations support
only the commands, toolchain and inputs that were actually recorded.
